CLIMATE RESILIENT AND SUSTAINABLE
  CITY COMMISSION AGENDA

  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD

Pete Marsh, Chair  Hilda Gaytan, Commissioner
Michael Bennett, Vice Chair  Pearl Hanks, Commissioner
Renate Boronowsky, Commissioner  Charles McCullough, Commissioner
Holland Brown, Commissioner  Christina Sergy, Commissioner
Keisha Gaines, Commissioner  Ryan Wolfe, Commissioner

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments to
  CityClerk@longbeach.gov

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55912  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Climate Resilient and Sustainable
  City Commission meeting of Thursday, June 25, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55913  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from City staff on Extreme
  Heat, Air Quality, and the Climate Action Plan.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55914  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55915  Recommendation to receive and file announcements and resources from the
  Office of Climate Action and Sustainability.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Climate Resilient and Sustainable City Commission on non-agenda
items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the
